_comment: OpenClaw command descriptor for checking/starting SupaAgent local services.
name: start_services
description: Check and start local SupaAgent services such as ComfyUI, blkkstarhub on localhost:3002, OpenClaw, and optional Unreal MCP.

only.description: Optional service name: comfyui, blkkstarhub, openclaw, or unreal_mcp

status_only.description: Check health only; do not start anything

dry_run.description: Show what would launch without starting processes

returns: Relay the line beginning SUPAAGENT_STATUS_JSON= and the human-readable service summary back to the user.
notes: only_flag => '-Only <service>' or '--only <service>' depending on shell adapter.
status_flag => '-StatusOnly' or '--status-only' when status_only is true.
dry_run_flag => '-DryRun' or '--dry-run' when dry_run is true.
This command starts local services only. It does not publish, post, message, spend money, or delete files.
